review_evidence: Grep count: 67 of 69 files have one or more declaration keywords; the files are hand-written Lean source for determinants, integer factorization, rank certificates, row reduction, sparse polynomials and truncated series.

Read HexRowReduce/RowEchelon.lean completely (420 B): `module`, two `public import` lines (Elementary, Contracts), `public section`, and a module docstring. Not pure import-only under FILTER-007; retained.

Read HexRowReduce/RowEchelon/Elementary.lean completely (300 B): `module`, `public import HexMatrix.ElementaryAlgebra`, `public section`, and a compatibility docstring. Not pure import-only under FILTER-007; retained.

Read the first 40 lines of HexSparsePolyMathlib/LintTests.lean and all of HexTruncatedSeriesMathlib/LintTests.lean: each defines a `docBlameThm'` linter and runs `#lint-` over the library. They hold declarations, so FILTER-004 does not apply; retained.
No generated data, benchmark output, or duplicate content was found in the listed files.
summary: Surveyed all 69 listed .lean files (300 B to 45 KB) under HexDetMathlib, HexIntFactor, HexIntFactorMathlib, HexPolyDet, HexRankMathlib, HexRowReduce, HexRowReduceMathlib, HexSparsePolyMathlib and HexTruncatedSeriesMathlib. A per-file declaration-keyword count (theorem|lemma|def|structure|class|instance|inductive|abbrev|example|axiom|macro|syntax|elab) found 67 files with at least one declaration. The 2 zero-declaration files are module re-exports that use `module` and `public section`, so they fall outside the pure-import class of FILTER-007 and stay primary-eligible. All 69 files are retained.
